description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them to git. Only ever adds a commit: never amends, rebases, resets, checks out or pushes.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N  maximum diff lines per file (default 150)
    --max-lines N  maximum lines of output overall (default 3000)
  save:
    --message  required. A single-line, non-empty commit subject
    --body  commit body; may span multiple lines
    --dry-run  report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log Northwind kickoff and follow-up tasks", "--body", "Meeting note, 2 actions flushed, 90 min logged."]
  ["save", "--message", "Record Northwind payment", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  Always run review first and write the summary from its output, then run save.
  Long diffs are truncated in review.
  Exit 1: empty or multi-line --message, the vault is not a git repository or not its root, or a git command failed.
